mission.text: Platform engineer who moves services onto Kubernetes, builds observability that shortens incidents, and keeps infrastructure costs down.
mission.rationale: Mirrors the posting's focus on platform reliability and ownership without adding claims beyond the knowledge base.

bullets.original: Led the migration of 42 services from VM-based deploys to Kubernetes, cutting deploy time from 45 minutes to 6 minutes
